{{Top|leg}}
'''Shieljar''' was a subscriber to [[Cynabar's Droid Datalog]]. Shieljar commented on the entry for the [[2-ZH surgical droid]], espousing the opinion that the [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] manufacturer naturally wanted a lock on the upgrade market in reply to [[Darvis]]' comment about in-built obsolescence.<ref name="CDD">{{JournalCite|13|Cynabar's Droid Datalog (article series)}}</ref>
